alt.en: A large gray map tile with a dashed border lies at the center of a gray floor, with two teal location pins on it. A dashed orange line with a packet runs from a camera on the right to one pin; a dotted dark gray line runs from the phone of a person in an orange coat on the left to the other pin.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央平放着一块带虚线边界的大幅灰色地图，上面立着两枚青色定位标记。右侧相机引出一条带数据包的橙色虚线，连到其中一枚标记；左侧身穿橙色外套的人手中的手机引出一条深灰色点线，连到另一枚标记。

caption.en: Illustration: a map with teal pins stands for the Agent 365 registry Microsoft describes, where a camera stands for discovery of local agents and a person for the administrator who views it. It does not depict a tested deployment, Microsoft's software or real agents, and it does not show that discovery or monitoring work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：插着青色标记的地图代表 Microsoft 所描述的 Agent 365 注册表，相机代表对本地智能体的发现，人物代表查看注册表的管理员。图中并非经过测试的部署，也不是 Microsoft 的软件或真实的智能体，并不表明发现或监测功能如其所述般有效。
